# stb (vendored)

`stb_image.h` (v2.30) and `stb_image_write.h` (v2.30) from
https://github.com/nothings/stb — single-file public-domain/MIT-0 image decode/encode used
only by the `agora_icon` development tool (the port of `scripts/round_icon.py`). The full
license text rides at the top of each header. Nothing in the Android app links these files.
